Generic `SO-SFP-L50D-Cxx` / `-Cxx-E` have no ordering row with a channel, so they are omitted. Shared technical data (nominal 1270–1610 nm, G.694.2 grid, GbE and 1G FC, 1.0625/1.25 Gbps) applies to every listed SKU.

**Note:** `SO-SFP-L50D-Cxx` and `SO-SFP-L50D-Cxx-E` are family placeholders in the title only; the ordering table does not assign a channel to them, so they are not given modes here. GbE and 1G FC (and 1.0625 Gbps for FC) are supported on the same SKUs but are not split into separate modes because ordering is one row per SKU and the schema has a single `standards_code` / `bit_rate_gbps` per mode. No per-mode penalties were supplied. If you need 38 modes including `Cxx` or protocol/bit-rate splits (e.g. 72 modes), say how you want those mapped.
